title: Alabama lawyer quit practice to care for parents; court voids her condo deed
description: The Alabama Supreme Court has affirmed a lower court's ruling that invalidated a property transfer from parents to their daughter, Holly Schumpert. Despite her dedication in caring for her ailing parents, the court determined the coastal condominium was part of a family trust, rendering the deed null. As a result, laws designed to protect elderly property owners allowed the reversal, leading to Holly having no claim to the estate.

Mahomes joined the investor group alongside Travis Kelce and other high-profile names through Otro Capital. Alpine’s rising value reflects Formula 1’s growing commercial appeal. However, Mahomes’ individual investment amount and ownership stake have not been publicly disclosed.

title: ‘Grabbed hair, tore shirt’: Patient attacks doctor, hospital staff in Punjab

The violent incident occurred during treatment when Singh attacked the doctor and a nurse. Hospital staff intervened and subdued Singh before police intervention. Following the incident, the Punjab Civil Medical Services Association called for improved security measures. A deadline was set for November 12 to enhance safety at sub-divisional hospitals in Punjab.

The wife and three children consumed rat poison after the husband verbally abused them. As their condition worsened, the eldest daughter called for emergency assistance. All four family members were taken to a local hospital and later referred to a hospital in Delhi.

Bhau allegedly runs an organized crime network responsible for killings, extortion, and illegal activities. Local authorities are engaging with students directly to build trust and offer help as needed. Counseling and wellness programs have been integrated to support mental health in coaching centers.

title: Nasa’s Isaacman shares Artemis IV update as SpaceX, Blue Origin plan Moon base
description: NASA administrator Jared Isaacman provided an update regarding the Artemis III lunar mission and upcoming docking exercises. The agency plans for significant interactions with Elon Musk's SpaceX and Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin next year. Docking practices will involve astronaut teams launching aboard NASA's Orion capsule from Cape Canaveral. Isaacman indicated that the competition has intensified due to historical precedents set by earlier space missions.

Police received information about her death and quickly arrived at the scene. Authorities have registered a case and are investigating the circumstances of her passing.

title: Travis Kelce's $5.35 million estate faces opposition over landscaping plans
description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion faces fresh delays as neighbors challenge his landscaping and fencing plans. Residents have raised concerns about wildlife safety, lake views and potential damage to an aging sewer line, with one neighbor citing $75,000 in repair costs. Kelce’s construction team says it has spent $7,500 on sewer repairs and adjusted the plans. However, local officials require further changes before the remaining landscaping work can proceed.

title: Biosimilar drugs breaking high-cost barrier to cancer immunotherapy
description: Recent changes in cancer care in India show an increase in immunotherapy prescriptions due to affordable biosimilars. Doctors report that the availability of cheaper versions of nivolumab has improved patient access to treatment. Research indicates that lower doses may be effective for Indian patients, contributing to the affordability of therapy. Although progress has been made, significant challenges remain regarding drug availability and hospital practices.

title: Rocket founder Dan Gilbert forgoes profits on $2.2 billion Detroit redevelopment
description: Dan Gilbert has pledged a remarkable $1 billion towards the revitalization of the Renaissance Center and Detroit's east riverfront. By establishing a nonprofit, this investment is transformed into a philanthropic donation, prioritizing community well-being over profit. After covering initial costs, future revenues will support local initiatives and foster public spaces, aiming to breathe new life into the aging infrastructure while enriching the community's cultural landscape.
